test_design_notes: Mixed scope: basic XML templates, navigation, iteration, serialization and getAttributes checks share main with excluded query interpolation and qualified-name expressions.

Output markers assert exact namespace placement, prefixes, whitespace and serialization; the DOCTYPE/entity fromString check also asserts entity expansion. These are behavioral assertions beyond method availability, but the explicit syntax exclusions already decide the whole case.
Several query results are assigned directly to xml and query actions use do; these introduce additional coverage questions beyond the documented list/map query constructors and expression clauses.
No obvious output-marker mismatch; multiline expected serialization is represented by successive @output comments. io:println is instrumentation.
